### Can You Spot a False Teacher?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-june-23-2024.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:3-5
Points:
- Spiritual discernment is essential to identify deceptive and false teachers in the church.
- False teachers often look genuine on the surface, mimicking biblical ministry and practices.
- Believers are susceptible when they treat spiritual discernment casually rather than doing careful study.
- Christians must actively pray for eyes to recognize and guard against deceptive doctrines.

### The Pathology of False Teachers
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/print/B140214/the-pathology-of-false-teachers
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:3-5
Points:
- Church leaders must diagnose false teaching, which attacks sound doctrine and godly living.
- False teachers are governed by pride and ignorance, exalting their opinions above Scripture.
- An obsession with controversial disputes inevitably creates division, envy, and strife.
- Corrupt and depraved minds ultimately exploit religion for personal financial gain.
